boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_interrupt.c, 0x02056d64..0x02057014: 9 functions. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/OS_interrupt.c, compiled with its own pinned mwccarm 1.2/sp2p3, emits OS_SetIrqStackChecker 0x34, OS_ResetRequestIrqMask 0x34, OS_DisableIrqMask 0x48, OS_EnableIrqMask 0x38, OS_SetIrqMask 0x34, OSi_EnterTimerCallback 0x4c, OSi_EnterDmaCallback 0x4c, OS_GetIrqFunction 0x8c, OS_SetIrqFunction 0x90, OS_InitIrqTable 0x18; the run here has the last nine in that order: ClearInterrupts, DisableIRQs, EnableIRQs, SetIRQs, OSi_EnterTimerCallback, OSi_EnterDmaCallback, GetIRQHandler and SetIRQHandler at pret's sizes, then OS_InitIrqTable at 0x14. OS_SetIrqStackChecker is absent because nothing in this game calls it.
TOP EDGE: OS_UnLockCartridge at 0x02057014 opens os_spinLock.c (arm9/OS_SpinLock).
BOTTOM EDGE: EmptyHandler (OS_IrqDummy) at 0x02056d60 ends os_irqTable.c (arm9/OS_IrqTable).
Split from the former arm9/IRQ, which held both SDK files in one TU because its members share the IRQ:: namespace.
notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows arm9/GX_VramCnt.

The coined IRQ:: members now carry their SDK names from pret/pokediamond OS_interrupt.c (OS_ResetRequestIrqMask, OS_DisableIrqMask, OS_EnableIrqMask, OS_SetIrqMask, OS_GetIrqFunction, OS_SetIrqFunction) with C linkage, declared in include/nitro/os/interrupt.h; the three C-linkage members, first named func_02057000, func_02056e98 and func_02056e4c, stay under extern "C" with the signatures their shards defined; they now carry their SDK names OS_InitIrqTable, OSi_EnterDmaCallback and OSi_EnterTimerCallback (symbols/actor_renames.tsv).
Text-only: no data is claimed here.
PC port: smoke_gx hostgens OSi_EnterDmaCallback by symbol, which emits this whole file; everything else is under #ifndef _MSC_VER because port/ntr/runtime.cpp supplies the host interrupt registry.
